notes: v274 — PTI-SIGNATURE-NOT-SAVED (owner, Mon Oct 26, 2026 18:27 MDT, his screen recording of the post-trip filing: the Sign & file box opened EMPTY though he had signed the pre-trip that same morning — 'Why is it not saving my signature?'). PROVEN CAUSE (modules/pti.js only): there was NO saved-signature store at all. The drawn signature lived only on the in-progress draft (pti_draft.sig, v170) and on filed reports; fileInspection wipes the draft to blankDraft() after every successful filing — sig:'' with it — so the next form opened empty by construction and he redrew every time. v241's PTI-SIGNATURE-SAVE had verified the REPORTS write (a filed signature could no longer be lost silently); it never gave the app a signature memory. FIX: the plate's set-once law, for the pen. A new key pti_sigsave holds the saved signature: (1) a signature that lands on a filed report (Sign & file, verified write first) becomes the saved signature; (2) a FRESH form — nothing answered, no odometer yet, no signature drawn — opens with the saved signature seeded onto the draft and painted in the box, so what the box shows is exactly what files, no redraw needed; (3) drawing again replaces it — the new drawing files and becomes the saved copy at that filing; (4) the sign-later card on an unsigned report opens with the saved signature too, and a signature that signs there becomes the saved one. HONESTY KEPT: Clear still empties the box for that form — a cleared form files NOTHING (validation still demands a drawing), the saved copy is untouched by Clear, and it does NOT sneak back into the same in-progress form on the error re-render (only a fresh draft is ever seeded), so no inspection can file as Signed off a signature that is not actually in its form. The unsigned badge behaviour is unchanged. PROOF: new tools/pti-signature-persist-v274-test.js 19/19 — RED on the pre-fix tree with 12 failures reproducing the incident (draw + file, next form empty; a seeded saved signature ignored; the saved copy never updated by a redraw or a sign-later signing), GREEN after; its W4 worlds pin the Clear law on both trees.
